Changes: NLSGallery keeps the populated places of cities1000 except the historical, abandoned and destroyed ones, their admin1 regions from admin1CodesASCII and their countries from countryInfo, packed into places.bin, with a few everyday names of countries added ("usa", "uk", "holland").
